target.label: Real-Venue Launch Readiness - Performance, Trust, Hours, Console Hygiene

remediation_assessment.finding: Current Story 12.3/12.7/12.11/12.12 AC-to-test evidence was consumed. It confirms local deterministic coverage, Story 12.11 serialized 3/3 pass, and Story 12.11 prior parallel 2/3 result, but does not provide verified protected/live evidence for the P0 launch lanes. Counts and gate verdict remain unchanged.

Feedback evidence, public verdict parity, invalid contradiction rejection, aggregation/reporting, and coverage-cap removal are traced as 8/8 FULL.

Persisted geometry/hash, request-count, missing-coverage 503, weather re-gating, day-plus-three degradation, rollover, service-role local/security tests, scheduled runner evidence, and current story AC-to-test evidence are traced as covered in deterministic lanes.
Protected production 42+ venue cold-p95 evidence is not collected.
requirements.gap: No protected-production dataset proves p95 <= approximately 5s with route/date/hash/run metadata, edge/warm/cold classification, logs proving persisted geometry reads, and zero request-path provider or shadow recompute.

requirements.coverage: Protected GitHub Production environment and live protected Supabase advisor evidence are not collected.

gate_decision.deterministic_rule: P0 coverage is below 100% because required protected-production, migration, and storage-policy evidence lanes remain PARTIAL.
gate_decision.rationale: Epic 12 implementation coverage is broad, including the newly consumed AC-to-test evidence for Stories 12.3, 12.7, 12.11, and 12.12, but gate iteration 2 still has no verified remediation evidence closing the protected/live P0 lanes. Missing live/protected operational evidence cannot be substituted with local deterministic tests.
